description: Open, pause, resume and close the knight game around Claude's turns

hooks.command: echo `# <#` >/dev/null; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" start; exit 0 #> > $null; foreach ($p in 'python','py','python3') { if (Get-Command $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $input | & $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook.py" start; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break } } }

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" notify; exit 0 #> > $null; foreach ($p in 'python','py','python3') { if (Get-Command $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $input | & $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook.py" notify; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break } } }

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" stop; exit 0 #> > $null; foreach ($p in 'python','py','python3') { if (Get-Command $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $input | & $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook.py" stop; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break } } }

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" end; exit 0 #> > $null; foreach ($p in 'python','py','python3') { if (Get-Command $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $input | & $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hook.py" end; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break } } }
